card.name: Glucose monitor interference warnings
card.fires_on: Linking words and hyphen endings right after glucose-testing terms (glucose-specific, GDH-based, interfere with, results from) in warnings about falsely high readings. Also fires on the word after an implant name, such as 'implant' before 'removed'.
